<section class="mod_article grid-center block" id="article-1260">
<h1 class="ce_headline col-12_md-8">Mobile Homes</h1>
<h2 class="ce_headline col-12_md-8">A Beach House Meets a Camping Vibe</h2>
<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-8 block">
<p>Our mobile homes are your hassle-free vacation home at the Wulfener Hals camping and vacation park. Look forward to thoughtfully designed comfort for 2&ndash;4 people, including made-up beds, a dishwasher, a TV, and&mdash;depending on the model&mdash;even a whirlpool tub. Outdoor furniture and a covered patio or awning round out the cozy atmosphere.</p>
<p><strong>Your vacation rental&mdash;centrally located in our park</strong> <br>Our mobile homes and chalets are located just a few meters from the "Wulfener Hals" restaurant, the event terrace, and the Windsurfing Wulfen surf school.</p>
</div>
</section>

<div class="ce_text col-12_lg-8 block">
<h2>3. Chatel Model</h2>
<p><strong>19 m&sup2;, for 2 people</strong></p>
</div>
<div class="ce_hyperlink button button-primary col-12_md-4 block">
<a href="https://v3.onlinebooking.dk/V3WULFEN/?cbpid=397" class="hyperlink_txt" title="Jetzt Verf&uuml;gbarkeit pr&uuml;fen">Check Availability Now</a>
</div>
<div class="ce_text col-12 block">
<ul>
<li>1 living room/bedroom with a double bed (160 x 200 cm)</li>
<li>1 table, 2 armchairs, 1 mini kitchenette, TV, basic Wi-Fi included</li>
<li>Kitchenette: coffee maker, refrigerator, 2-burner ceramic cooktop, kitchen appliances, dishes, silverware, glasses, pots and pans, as well as hand towels and dish towels</li>
<li>Bathroom with shower and toilet</li>
<li>Bedding and towels are included in all mobile homes, vacation homes, and apartments. The beds are made.</li>
<li>Upon request: daily room service for EUR 18.00</li>
<li>Our recommendation: Book the breakfast buffet or half-board as well.</li>
</ul>

<div class="col-12_lg-5"><div class="text-box orange grid">
<div class="ce_text center block">
<h3>Traveling to the Baltic Sea with Toddlers</h3>
<p>Travel light&mdash;and for toddlers, we offer a special service: the Toddler Carefree Package. Rent everything you need for the duration of your vacation&mdash;from a travel crib to a high chair, playpen, and bottle warmer.</p>
